##### Project general facts

Island Heights is an exclusive collection of meticulously crafted residences ideally situated to take advantage of the many amenities and attractions of Al Marjan Island. Perfectly positioned close to the region's first interactive gaming resort and within walking distance of the beach, Island Heights promises enviable living and engaging entertainment. Architecturally, the development pays homage to classic elegance, its geometric silhouette defined with sleek sculptural precision, balancing visual appeal with functionality to create a residence that is at once aesthetically striking and eminently liveable.

Generously proportioned windows, extensive balconies and terraces, and expansive space maximize natural light and capitalize on magnificent panoramic views. At the building's podium level, a prominent outdoor area features a stunning infinity edge pool, along with a relaxed poolside lounge area offering panoramic views of the surrounding areas. The Residents' Lounge is a space for communal activities, co-working, and simple relaxation, with a calm, restful aesthetic, relaxed atmosphere, casual seating, and efficient workspaces ensuring an experience that is as productive or as laid back as desired.

Inside, the residences exude understated modern luxury and a calm, assured grace, with a light, muted palette, smooth, sinuous shapes, and cool, refined travertine-inspired textures. Throughout, the concept of 'timeless wonder' blends classic elegance with subtle elements of exploration and discovery. Interiors are warm and sophisticated, featuring elegant materials and finishes for a serene and welcoming ambience. Kitchens are fully equipped, creating homes that are both beautiful and functional.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Al Marjan Island, a stunning man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah, this exceptional location is one of the region's most prominent tourist destinations. Known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments, the island is shaped like a coral reef with four primary coral-shaped islands connected by a central boulevard, offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf.

The location is distinguished by its pristine white sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters, providing an ideal setting for sunbathing, swimming, and water sports. The island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts with world-class amenities, private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options, catering to both leisure and business travelers.

For those seeking a residence that embodies classic elegance, modern luxury, and a prime Ras Al Khaimah address, Al Marjan Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class entertainment, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of seaside living.
